item.text:
The exporter currently replaces commas in contact names but leaves commas in company names unescaped, so `Acme, Inc` becomes an extra column. The CSV writer also joins fields without quoting, which affects any field containing commas.

I haven’t changed the code yet. The existing CRM-731 comment says the sales importer requires unquoted fields, while the README says customer text must retain its contents. Those requirements conflict for comma-containing values. Should I update the exporter to use standard CSV quoting, or preserve the unquoted format and sanitize commas?
